paite: Kumpipa Zedekiah in Jeremiah kiang a Malkijah tapa Pashur leh siampu Maaseiah tapa Zephaniah asawl lai a Jeremiah kiang a TOUPA a kipan a thu hong tung ahi,
heading: Jerusalem Melmate Zoh A Om Ding Genkholhna
english: The word which came to Jeremiah from Yahweh, when king Zedekiah sent to him Pashhur the son of Malchijah, and Zephaniah the son of Maaseiah, the priest, saying,

paite: "Babilon kumpipa Nebukadnezzar in ahon dou a, TOUPA'N athilhih thupitak ahih sek bang in ahon huh nuam in, akiksak nawn mai kha diam chih TOUPA hon dotsak dih ve," chi in.
english: Please inquire of Yahweh for us; for Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon makes war against us: perhaps Yahweh will deal with us according to all his wondrous works, that he may go up from us.

paite: Huan Jeremiah in akiang uah, Zedekiah kiang ah hichibang in va gen un; Israel' Pathian, TOUPA'N hichi in achi:
english: Then Jeremiah said to them, You shall tell Zedekiah:

paite: "Ngai in, Babulon kumpipa leh Kaldai mi, kulh pua a nang hon umbichilhpa na douna galvan zat ka kiksak ding ahi; hiai khopi sung ah amaute ka pikhawm ding.
english: Thus says Yahweh, the God of Israel, Behold, I will turn back the weapons of war that are in your hands, with which you fight against the king of Babylon, and against the Chaldeans who besiege you, without the walls; and I will gather them into the midst of this city.

paite: Kei mahmah in leng heh leh lungkim lou mahmah leh thangpaitak in ban zak a ban thahat zang in nang ka hon dou ding.
english: I myself will fight against you with an outstretched hand and with a strong arm, even in anger, and in wrath, and in great indignation.

paite: Hiai khua a teng mihingte leh gante ka that ding a, hipi in asi ding uh."
english: I will strike the inhabitants of this city, both man and animal: they shall die of a great pestilence.

paite: Huai nung in, TOUPA thupawt in achi, "Kumpipa Zedekiah leh anungzuite leh midang hiai khua a hipi leh namsau leh kial a siloute, Babulon kumpipa leh amelmate uh khut leh amau thah tum mite khut ah ka pe ding. Namsau hiam in athat ding a, ahehpih het kei ding, ahawi het kei ding a, azahngai sam kei ding."
english: Afterward, says Yahweh, I will deliver Zedekiah king of Judah, and his servants, and the people, even such as are left in this city from the pestilence, from the sword, and from the famine, into the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and into the hand of their enemies, and into the hand of those who seek their life: and he shall strike them with the edge of the sword; he shall not spare them, neither have pity, nor have mercy.

paite: Huan hiai mipite kiang ah huchi in va gen in; TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Ngai un, sihna lampi leh hinna lampi ka hon koihsak hi.
english: To this people you shall say, Thus says Yahweh: Behold, I set before you the way of life and the way of death.

paite: Hiai khopi sung a om namsau in hiam kial in hiam hipi in hiam asi ding uh; Kaldai mite nou hon umbichilhpa kiang a pawt a kipete bel ahing ding uh, ahinna uh kidouna kipahman ahi ding hi.
english: He who remains in this city shall die by the sword, and by the famine, and by the pestilence; but he who goes out, and passes over to the Chaldeans who besiege you, he shall live, and his life shall be to him for a prey.

paite: Hiai khopi hoihna ding hilou, asiatna ding ka tum bilbel ahi; Babulon kumpipa khut a piak ahi ding a, ama'n mei in ahal ding," chih TOUPA thupawt ahi.
english: For I have set my face on this city for evil, and not for good, says Yahweh: it shall be given into the hand of the king of Babylon, and he shall burn it with fire.

paite: Judah kumpipa inkote tungtang thu ah; TOUPA thu ngaikhia un,
heading: Judah Kumpipa Inkuante Tung A TOUPA Thukhenna
english: Touching the house of the king of Judah, hear the word of Yahweh:

paite: Aw David inkote aw! TOUPA'N hichi in achi: "Zingsang in vai diktak in hawm unla, simmohmi khut a kipan loh thuakmi hunkhia un, huchi lou in zaw ka hehna mei bang in apawt ding a, kuamah phelh vual louh ding in akang dia, na thilhih giloute uh ziak in."
english: House of David, thus says Yahweh, Execute justice in the morning, and deliver him who is robbed out of the hand of the oppressor, lest my wrath go forth like fire, and burn so that none can quench it, because of the evil of your doings.

paite: "Ngai dih ua, phaizang zang a tengte aw, nou phaizang zang suangpi a teng a, 'Kuate ahia i omna ua hong lut ding?' chite aw, nou ka hon lang ding hi. TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: Behold, I am against you, O inhabitant of the valley, and of the rock of the plain, says Yahweh; you that say, Who shall come down against us? or who shall enter into our habitations?

paite: Na thilhih uh gah bang zel in ka hon gawt ding a, agam gammang ah mei ka khah ding a, akim tengteng akangmang ding," TOUPA thupawt in achi hi.
english: I will punish you according to the fruit of your doings, says Yahweh; and I will kindle a fire in her forest, and it shall devour all that is around her.
